name: Weaviate
tagline: Open-source AI-native vector database with hybrid search, modules for embeddings and multi-tenancy.
description: Weaviate is an open-source vector database written in Go that stores objects and their vectors together, with BM25 and hybrid search, filtering, multi-tenancy and pluggable vectorizer and generative modules that call OpenAI, Cohere, Hugging Face and others for you. It shards and replicates natively, offers tunable consistency, and supports PQ, BQ and rotational quantization to fit large indexes in memory. The core is BSD-3-Clause, while some enterprise features are now in a separately licensed directory. Weaviate Cloud provides shared (Flex) and dedicated (Premium) managed clusters.

license.name: BSD-3-Clause (core); enterprise features under the Weaviate License

pricing.notes: Free sandbox-style cluster (100K objects). Flex is pay-as-you-go on shared clusters; Premium is prepaid with dedicated options, HIPAA and SSO.

scale.notes: Sharding and Raft-based schema replication across nodes; tenants can be offloaded to object storage.

strengths: Hybrid BM25 plus vector search with fusion options in one query
Vectorizer and generative modules remove glue code for embeddings and RAG
Native multi-tenancy with tenant offloading to cold storage
Quantization (PQ/BQ/RQ) cuts memory for large indexes
Open-source core with a straightforward managed cloud
weaknesses: Memory-hungry HNSW unless you tune quantization
GraphQL-era API surface has been reworked several times
Enterprise features moving to a separate license
useCases: RAG over documents with hybrid retrieval
notIdealFor: Tiny embedded apps (use sqlite-vec or LanceDB)
